notes: Investment gold (bars, qualifying coins) is VAT-exempt; jewellery and other gold are 20% standard-rated; silver bullion is standard-rated. Used gold is also VAT-relevant (HMRC special accounting scheme for scrap). Dealer sites (Bullion By Post, gold.co.uk, Royal Mint etc.) could not be opened, so premiums, making charges and buyback are null.

sources.name: HMRC VAT Notice 701/21 Gold
sources.what: Investment gold exempt from VAT; other gold supplies (incl. jewellery/scrap) standard rated; silver treated as taxable

sources.name: LBMA/HMRC memorandum
sources.what: VAT treatment of bullion trades: investment gold exempt, London market zero-rating under Terminal Markets Order
